title: Data Engineer
desc: The Data Engineer is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the company’s data infrastructure — from raw data ingestion through to production-ready datasets that serve both operational systems and AI workloads. A core focus of this role is building a comprehensive metadata and semantic layer that clearly describes every dataset, table, and field, enabling AI systems to scan, analyze, and generate reports autonomously. This role works closely with the technical team, AI team, project team, and clients to ensure data is reliable, well-documented, and ready for both human analysis and machine consumption. Job Description: The Role Data Pipeline Development Design and build automated ETL/ELT pipelines to ingest data from multiple sources (Call Center, DMS, Social Platform, third-party APIs). Develop scheduling, monitoring, and alerting mechanisms to ensure pipeline reliability and SLA compliance. Implement incremental processing, deduplication, and change data capture (CDC) strategies for high-volume data flows. Maintain and optimize existing pipelines for performance, cost, and maintainability. Metadata & Semantic Layer Build and maintain a comprehensive metadata catalog with clear descriptions for every table and column across all datasets. Design and implement a semantic layer that defines dataset purposes, field definitions, data types, business logic, and relationships between tables. Ensure the semantic layer is structured for AI consumption — enabling AI systems to understand data context, scan datasets, perform analysis, and generate reports without manual intervention. Establish and enforce documentation standards so that every new dataset or schema change is accompanied by complete metadata. Collaborate with the AI team to validate that the semantic layer provides sufficient context for automated data exploration and insight generation. Data Quality & Governance Implement automated data quality checks at each pipeline stage: completeness, accuracy, consistency, and freshness. Build monitoring dashboards to track data health metrics and alert on anomalies or pipeline failures. Establish data lineage tracking so that downstream consumers (reports, dashboards, AI models) can trace data to its source. Collaborate with stakeholders to define data ownership, access policies, and retention rules. AI Data Infrastructure Prepare and serve datasets for AI/ML workloads: feature stores, training datasets, and inference data feeds. Collaborate with the AI team to define data requirements for model training, evaluation, and monitoring. Build and maintain data APIs or serving layers that enable AI systems to consume data in real time or near-real time. Support the AI team in data profiling, exploratory analysis, and data readiness assessments for new AI use cases. Cross-team Collaboration Work with the technical team on system integration and data flow architecture across platforms. Collaborate with the AI team to ensure data infrastructure meets the requirements of AI/ML workloads. Support the project team and clients in understanding data availability, structure, and operational workflows. Participate in client-facing discussions to gather data requirements and provide technical guidance on data solutions. Location: Ho Chi Minh City Brand: Merkle Time Type: Full time Contract Type: Fixed Term Contract (Fixed Term)

title: Data Engineer
desc: Job Location Weybridge Job Description Ready to make an impact on globally renowned brands like Gillette, Pampers, Head & Shoulders and Oral-B? Join our data engineering team at P&G, where business, innovation and technology come together to create a competitive advantage. This role is for a curious, practical problem-solver who wants to learn fast, build things that work and make a visible impact. As a Data Engineer, you will pioneer the application of technology to the solution of business problems by partnering closely with business teams to deeply understand their core challenges and strategic goals. Your primary focus will be on designing and building intelligent systems that can reason, plan, and execute tasks with a high degree of autonomy. This innovation focused role requires you to translate business needs into novel agentic solutions, taking responsibility for the full development lifecycle from rapid prototyping to building robust, scalable solutions. What You Can Expect: Collaborate directly with business stakeholders to identify, understand, and define high-impact opportunities for the application of technology. Lead the conceptualization and rapid prototyping of AI-based proof of concepts; demonstrate value, fail fast. Architect and build intelligent production solutions to identified opportunities utilising the optimal data engineering tool-set; with a focus on Agentic AI. Own the full product development lifecycle, ensuring the final systems are robust, scalable, and align with governance frameworks. Architect, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines. This includes integrating with existing data sources and applying software engineering practices to ensure data reliability, security and quality. Collaborate with Cloud/Infrastructure teams to provision and configure the necessary environments development, including cloud resources, container orchestration platforms, and databases. Develop and maintain robust, automated data pipelines that feed real-time and batch data to AI agents for reasoning and tool use, ensuring data quality and reliability. Implement and manage CI/CD pipelines using tools like GitHub Actions to automate the testing, containerization, and deployment of AI agents, data pipelines, and infrastructure as code. Package and deploy AI agents as scalable and secure microservices using containers (Docker) and API frameworks (e.g., FastAPI, Flask), ensuring they can be integrated into broader business systems. Develop user interfaces and interactive demos for key stakeholders. Implement comprehensive monitoring to track agent performance, decision accuracy, tool usage, and resource consumption, creating automated alerts and evaluation frameworks. Work directly with business units to integrate agent-driven capabilities into their workflows and applications, helping to measure and communicate the resulting business impact. What We Offer You: Meaningful work from Day 1: You'll be working on some of the UK's best loved brands, with the space and opportunity to bring your experience, energy and new perspectives and make a genuine impact right from the start. Continuous development: At P&G we offer a career, not just a job. You'll be empowered to become the best at what you do through continuous learning, day-to-day coaching from your manager, a varied career path and the chance to work alongside inspiring people. Empowering culture: You'll collaborate on impactful projects in a supportive environment where our company values are embraced and diversity is celebrated. Competitive benefits: P&G takes a Total Rewards approach. On top of your competitive salary of £45,000, which is reviewed annually, you can expect a double-matched pension scheme, private health insurance, participation in a stock ownership scheme, 25 days holiday and your very own 'Flex4Me' Fund, which lets you allocate a portion of your benefits package to the areas that matter most to you. Job Qualifications What We Look For: You have a Bachelor's or Master's degree in a quantitative field such as Computer Science, Engineering, Maths, Statistics, Operations Research or Analytics. You have an experimental, iterative approach and are excited by the challenge of pioneering new solutions in ambiguous environments. A deep curiosity for autonomous AI and its practical application would be particularly useful. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a proven ability to partner with non-technical stakeholders, understand business challenges, and translate them into technical requirements. A proactive, self-motivated attitude with strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Fluency in English (written and oral). Technical experience (foundational experience in several of these is enough): Strong proficiency in Python Solid understanding of software engineering best practices, automated testing, and writing clean, maintainable code. Experience with SQL for complex data querying and manipulation. Demonstrable experience/understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs) and ideally familiarity with agentic frameworks and libraries Hands-on experience building and orchestrating data pipelines Practical knowledge of CI/CD automation, specifically using GitHub Actions, to build, test, and deploy code and infrastructure. Experience with containerization (Docker) and deploying applications as APIs using frameworks like FastAPI or Flask. desc: At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Job Description The Quantitative Model Validation Analyst role resides within the Bank’s Risk Management and Compliance organization. Specifically, this position supports the Bank’s Model Risk Management (MRM) program. The overall MRM program is designed to provide governance, oversight, and control processes to effectively identify, measure, monitor, and manage model risk across the enterprise. Quantitative Model Validation Analysts within MRM provide independent and effective challenge of models that the Bank relies upon for critical business, financial, and risk management decisions. More specifically, the incumbent will be a member of the team responsible for the independent validation of macroeconomic forecasting models used in regulatory and business planning processes, including CCAR, CECL, capital planning and other business-as-usual (BAU) activities. The incumbent will work closely with Model Owners and Developers to perform thorough, risk-focused validations and independently challenge model assumptions, theoretical foundations, estimation techniques, variable selection methodologies, forecasting performance, scenario design, sensitivity analyses, and outcome reasonableness. Validation activities will be conducted in compliance with regulatory guidance, and the Bank’s Model Risk Management Policy and Standards. The incumbent will be responsible for assessing model risks, limitations, uncertainties, and potential sources of forecast error, and for providing independent conclusions regarding model appropriateness and fitness for use. The role requires strong analytical and quantitative skills, including experience with econometric modeling, time-series analysis, macroeconomic forecasting, stress testing methodologies, and statistical model performance evaluation. The incumbent will be expected to conduct independent testing, benchmarking, back-testing, sensitivity analysis, and other validation procedures to evaluate model conceptual soundness, ongoing performance, and compliance with regulatory expectations. The incumbent will document validation procedures, findings, and conclusions in comprehensive validation reports and present results to model owners, developers, governance committees, and executive management. He/she will regularly interact with key stakeholders across Risk Management, Finance, Treasury, and Business Lines, and will interface with regulators (OCC and Federal Reserve) and Internal Audit to explain validation approaches, findings, model risk assessments, and remediation recommendations. The ability to clearly communicate complex quantitative concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences is essential for success in this role. Basic Qualifications - Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field, and five or more years of relevant experience OR - MA/MS in a quantitative field, and three or more years of related experience OR - PhD in a quantitative field, and less than two years of related experience Preferred Skills/Experience · Excellent knowledge in economics, finance, statistics, and mathematics · Proficient in the Python, SAS, and R programming languages · Experience in macroeconomic forecast model development or validation, and experience in stress testing models · Critical thinking, problem solving, and creativity · Strong written and verbal communication skills (ability to explain complex ideas in simple, non-technical language) · Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with peers, business line managers, and colleagues across the bank · Highly motivated with the ability to learn and to understand various business lines and their functions within the organization · Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team environment. · Strong organizational skills and the ability to work on multiple tasks effectively · Knowledge of regulatory guidance LOCATION EXPECTATIONS: This role requires working from a U.S. Bank Location three (3) or more days per week. title: Financial Reporting Analyst
desc: At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe. JOB SUMMARY The position is an entry-level role that supports the Company’s global lease accounting and financial reporting processes. Working under direct supervision and established procedures. The analyst will review lease agreement, prepare lease analysis, maintain accurate lease data, and support lease disclosures for the Company’s external financial reports. The role requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work collaboratively with various cross-functional partners to obtain complete and accurate information. The analyst will also assist with technical accounting research, process improvement, and other special projects. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES Technical Accounting - Leases · Review lease agreements and other supporting documents to identify lease terms and ensure required documentation is complete. · Prepare lease accounting analyses in accordance with U.S. GAAP ASC 842 · Assist with the preparation and validation of lease-related information used in the Company’s Form 10-Q and Form 10-K filings. · Support monthly, quarterly, and annual close activities and complete assigned deliverables within established deadlines. · Research lease accounting guidance and document conclusions for routine accounting questions, with guidance from senior team members. · Complete ad hoc analyses and special projects as requested by management. JOB QUALIFICATIONS KNOWLEDGE, EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting. • 0-2 years of experience. • The ability to identify, understand a problem and its root cause, and research effective solutions. • Strong attention to detail and organization. • Demonstrates strong written and oral communication skills. • Proficiency in understanding and use of Excel. • Strong sense of teamwork and collaboration with an emphasis on building solid working relationships. • Demonstrated knowledge of Accounting concepts, Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (U.S. GAAP) and SEC reporting requirements. • Simultaneously balances multiple responsibilities; prioritizes tasks based on urgency and relevance. • Results driven and ability to meet deadlines. • Understanding of the political and societal impacts on business across multiple countries. • Ability to extract and analyze data to identify trends, anomalies and differences.
